name: si.sigit/cli
title: siGit CLI
description: Run sigit.si locally: browse repos, search code, manage PRs, issues, and Cloud Sessions.

packageArguments.description: Serve the CLI's commands as MCP tools over stdio instead of running one of them.

packageArguments.name: --read-only
packageArguments.description: Drop every tool that writes, leaving only the ones that read.

packageArguments.name: --toolsets
packageArguments.description: Comma-separated groups to expose, out of account, repo, issue, pr, code, hook, session, and billing. Defaults to all of them.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: sigit.si session token. Optional: the server otherwise reuses whatever `si auth login` stored.

environmentVariables.name: SIGIT_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: The environment form of --toolsets, for clients that pass configuration as variables rather than arguments.
